title: Bayan Run 2026 Review: A Kalimantan Half Marathon from Indonesia's Coal Giant
seo_title: Bayan Run 2026 Review | Balikpapan Kalimantan Indonesia Race
meta_description: Bayan Run 2026: October 11 in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan. 21K to 800m kids from PT Bayan Resources — one of Indonesia's rarest race locations reviewed.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, this PT Bayan Resources-organised run offers five distances. A coal-mining company's CSR road race in one of Indonesia's most remote race destinations — Kalimantan (Borneo).
verdict: Bayan Run 2026 brings a multi-distance road race to Balikpapan, East Kalimantan — one of Indonesia's most remote and under-represented race destinations on the island of Borneo. Organised by PT Bayan Resources, one of Indonesia's largest coal mining companies, as part of its CSR programme, the event offers five distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 2.5K, 800m kids). Registration is coming soon. For runners wanting a genuinely rare Indonesian race location — Kalimantan has perhaps the smallest running calendar of any major Indonesian island — this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Kalimantan: Indonesia's Wild Frontier
paragraphs: Balikpapan is East Kalimantan's largest city and the gateway to Borneo's rainforest interior. [1] Road races in Kalimantan are extremely rare — this is one of the few listed on any regional calendar. PT Bayan Resources' corporate backing means professional logistics and a well-resourced race-day operation.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A genuinely rare Kalimantan road race with corporate backing. Registration coming soon. 11 October 2026 in Balikpapan. [1]
